basic_details.job_title: DPSRU Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 6 Senior Project Associate, Research Associate Posts
basic_details.short_information: Delhi Pharmaceutical Sciences and Research University (DPSRU), New Delhi, has invited applications for 6 posts in 2 roles under Advt No. ANRF/PAIR/2025/000029/PAIR. The posts include Senior Project Associate, Research Associate-I. Selection is through a walk-in interview on 30 October 2026.

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Four years Bachelor's Degree in Natural Sciences / Master's Degree in Natural Sc/BVSc / BPharm or bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine or equivalent

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Four years Bachelor's Degree in Natural Sciences / Master's Degree in Natural Sc/BVSc / BPharm or bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent; Master's Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized university or equivalent; Doctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Pharma MD / Master of Surgery from a recognized University or equivalent. Experience required: Four years' experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organizations for bachelor/master holders, Two years for M.Tech holders. Age limit: Maximum 50 years. Pay: 57000 +HRA 30%. Qualification required: Four years Bachelor's Degree in Natural Sciences / Master's Degree in Natural Sciences / BVSc / B. Pharm or Bac

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 57,000 to Rs. 58,000, depending on the post

how_to_apply: Bring filled-in application form along with one set of self-attested photocopies of certificates and testimonials.
Bring all original documents for verification at the walk-in venue.
Attend on 30 October 2026, reporting at 9:00 AM.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in-interview
